# OpenID Connect Core 1.0 examples

Some literals in `test/request.test.ts` and `test/redirect.test.ts` are retyped from the examples of OpenID Connect Core
1.0 incorporating errata set 2, section 3.1.2.1 (Authentication Request), section 3.1.2.5 (Successful Authentication
Response) and section 3.1.2.6 (Authentication Error Response), published at
https://openid.net/specs/openid-connect-core-1_0.html (read on 2026-10-06). Each is marked "OpenID Connect Core" and its
section in the test that uses it. Only the short example addresses are retyped; no other text of the specification is
copied.
